column1: # MI1 (the Ultimate Talkie korean.trs) supplements, bake-supplements.py: what the text and M1KO.MAP draw that a base
# face lacks (the one syllable outside KS X 1001, the ellipsis and trademark sign the map remaps to), in the base's
# cell and baseline. Fields: supplement, base face, TTF, size, [mkfont.py flags]; see m2x.tsv. The Taebaek jamo sets
# (TBGOB24, TBMY24) and neodgm's (NEODG16C) compose every syllable and carry U+2026 and U+25A1: they need none.
# Supplement names: the base's font stem cut to 3 letters, its px and variant, X, the game (1 = MI1, 2 = MI2)
